homonyms.basis: No homonym on the rail: its one card is the entity's homepage. The MMRS record has no disambiguation of its own for CodeSOTA; the records of Papers with Code and of its revival disambiguate CodeSOTA from them ('codesota.com, /api/sota, 'refreshed live''; 'codesota.com, routing layer, /api/sota'; negative tags 'NOT CodeSOTA'). The entities around the name are distinct entities, kept as relations, never senses: Papers with Code (paperswithcode.com, 2018–2025), which CodeSOTA claims succession to, and the revival at paperswithcode.co, the name's third claimant. 'SOTA' in the name is the field's abbreviation for state of the art, not another referent.

One card: the homepage.
